lines.text: 4.8 Raw Materials from Fishery and Farming help to Generate Revenues
A.RawMaterialsfromFishery
1.Animal feed
Offal from the fishing industry can be used as afeed ingredient, as it is source of protein.
1f.oil
Fishes contains large amount of oil. In some developed countries this product generates large
amount of revenues.
ii.Foodindustry/cosmetics
Sea waste can be used in food industry. This waste include enzymes, gelatin and proteins
that have antimicrobial and antitumor capabilities. Chitosan, produced from shrimp and crab
shell, hasapplications in cosmeticand pharmaceutical industries.
B.RawMaterialsfromFarming
Materials left on land after the crop has been harvested are termed as crop residues. Crop
residues is considered tobe an effectiveanti-erosion measure.Crop residues can improve soil
structure,increase organic matter content in thesoil,reduce eyaporation,and helpfix carbon
dioxide in the soil.
Good residue management have many positive impacts on soil quality. It is also used for
generating biogas and some remains are used as animal fodder, sugarcane residues are used for
making chip-board. Crops residues help to generate revenues.
4.9Factors,AffectingAgricultureYield
There are 4 main factors that affect agriculture yield:
a)SoilFertility
There are many nutrients which are essential for proper crop development. Soil is a major source
of these nutrients to plants and therefore soil fertility has a profound impact on crop
production.
b) Availabilityofwater
The availability of water has a direct impact on agriculture yield. Little precipitation can
reduce crop yield,while excessive precipitation can also cause cropproduction to decrease.
c) Climate
Climate is also important factor that influence crop production. Climatic conditions include
humidity, temperature, wind etc.
d) DiseaseorPests
Pests and diseases greatly influence crop yield as well. Certain pests also damage plant roots
besides having a direct damage on crops.
